title: Exponential Decay of $L^2$-Solutions to Stochastic Nonlinear Schrödinger Equations Driven by Continuous Martingales
summary: We investigate the global well-posedness and asymptotic behavior of $L^2$-solutions to stochastic nonlinear Schrödinger equations with multiplicative noise driven by continuous square integrable martingales with density. Our approach relies on a rescaling transformation that converts the stochastic system into a random nonlinear Schrödinger equation with a potential acting as a damping term. Unlike the standard Brownian motion case, this induced potential plays a critical role in the dynamics.
